headline: The heterotic qutrit gauge register migrates from E6 to A8=SU9: the complete Pauli firewall excludes dim(E6)=78 from any three-qutrit Pauli-stable simple algebra, while sl9 (dim 80) is exactly the W33 two-qutrit Pauli algebra. In the actual W33-class Standard-Model flagship, the order-three Wilson line has 5+2+2 SU9 spectrum and is projectively conjugate to qutrit CZ_3, whose W33 action is 1^4 3^12 with one fixed isotropic line.

negative_branch.three_qutrit_E6_action: excluded, including nonmonomial/projective actions preserving the cubic up to scale

revised_729_reading.exact: C^27_fixed tensor C^27_E6 has dimension 729 and the stored F3^6 basis is a valid carrier-level coordinate system
revised_729_reading.physical_qutrits_certified: three geometric/fixed-point flavour qutrits; separately, the W33 A8 gauge algebra is a native two-qutrit operator algebra

scope: Projective CZ is a conjugacy-class statement; no preferred simultaneous heterotic/Pauli basis is fixed, and the five top couplings are not identified with the five CZ phase-zero basis states.
